Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Is putting "a minion from any ash heap into play to represent a wraith" a
recruit action (for purposes such as Breath of Thanatos or Shroud Mastery) ?

Thanks

--
Orpheus, unofficial Shemti model.

Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
Orpheus schrieb:


IANLSJ but if it would be a recruit action it would say "as a recruit
action" or "recruit any minion" or something like that. "Put into play"
is more a free-form action that isn't covered by action-type-connected
cards.

So the answer is: no :)
